nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Gentle Cream-to-Foam Face Cleanser

segments.sensitive: The great majority of sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea or allergy-prone skin, report no irritation, no breakouts and a hydrated, non-stripped feel after washing; a minority, mostly describing a reported formula change, report a rash, redness or a dry, tight after-feel instead.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe dry or itchy dry skin generally say the cleanser soothes without stripping, and 'dry sensitive skin' reviewers call it deeply hydrating; one reviewer with very dry, oil-overproducing skin instead says a reformulated version caused breakouts, a hard-to-remove film and increased oiliness.
segments.oily: The one review that specifically addresses oiliness reports the cleanser helped control greasy, sweaty skin after a workout, describing it as light and non-greasy afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (or combination/sensitive) skin report their face never feels dry or less than clean after washing.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age report the cleanser fits a gentle routine as skin matures: one at 40 with sensitive skin says it stopped the redness and breakouts other products caused, while another at 50 with sensitive skin found her skin drier than before.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, describe the cleanser as leaving skin soft, clean and hydrated without tightness or stripping, crediting ingredients like glycerin and colloidal oatmeal; a couple of reviewers instead report a dry, tight after-feel, including one with sensitive, maturing skin, and one who blames a reformulation for a hard-to-rinse film and skin that no longer felt moisturized.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea say the colloidal oatmeal reduces redness, and others who normally turn red or break out when trying new products report that did not happen with this cleanser; one reviewer instead says a reformulated version caused a rash and redness on her allergy-prone skin.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some prone to stress-related or hormonal acne, rosacea or psoriasis, report no new breakouts and calmer skin; conversely, several 1-star reviews describe a reportedly reformulated version causing renewed breakouts and even cystic acne after years of clear skin, and one reviewer noted a handful of tiny zits after her first use that did not recur.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the cleanser leaves skin refreshed and smooth without oiliness, and one credits it with cutting through greasy, sweaty skin after a workout; one reviewer with very dry, oil-overproducing skin instead reports a reformulated version increased her skin's oil levels and left a film that was hard to rinse off.

aspects.libelle: Rich, creamy texture that foams with water
A little product goes a long way
Pump dispenser clogs or wastes product
Struggles to fully remove waterproof mascara
Fragrance-free, prized by sensitive skin users
A few reviewers dislike a lingering scent

extraits.texte: I loved the old formula and had been using it for years! It kept my skin clear as I used to have adult acne and the previous better formula kept all of that gone. Now after trying this new formula it has caused me to breakout again and even with cystic acne now. Do not recommend using this any longer and will now be looking for something else to clear my skin since this is no longer a holy grail! I hope FAB changes it back and soon!

Have been using this product for years and loved it. I always have a difficult time finding something for my sensitive skin. I have bad allergies, and this was great once I found it. Unfortunately with the formula change, I can no longer use it. So disappointed in the rash and redness it now causes. At first I didn't realize it changed, I thought maybe it was just the packaging, but I was wrong. Why change such a good product? :(

I have been a FAB fan for years. I have adult acne and it's not uncommon to have a bit of redness to my face. When I started their old formulation of the Ultra Gentle Cleanser, it helped my skin clear up in days. My acne just disappeared. I couldn't believe it. I have very dry skin that if it isn't kept mousitized enough overproduces oil and this old formulation kept that oil at bay. I became someone who told EVERYONE about FAB. I felt like I had found the Holy Grail. But then they changed the formula. I wanted to give them credit so I used a whole bottle. One, it caused me the break out. It wasn't terrible but I definitely had zits and a less smooth face for the first time in years. Two, I found it extremely difficult to get off. The cleanser leaves a weird film on my skin. I don't know if it's intentional or not but I hated how it felt and getting it off included a lot more water and time than before. Third, the oil levels on my skin increased so much. I can't believe how FAB took a perfect cleanser and made it into this. It's such a disappointment and now I'm trying to find something to replace it and failing. If you liked the old formulation, this isn't the one for you anymore.

extraits.titre: Great for sensitive yet oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This creamy cleanser first starts as a scent free cream and once you add water, it foams up to thoroughly clean your face. I even tried this to remove eye makeup in a pinch while traveling and it did take off my mascara as needed. Like other First Aid Beauty products, my sensitive skin had zero reaction to this product and I appreciated that is was scent free. However, my skin did feel dry and tight after use so I think this would be awesome for sensitive, more oily skin. I have maturing (50), sensitive skin and it is dryer than before. I can't help but think this would be great for people who are struggling with both sensitivity and acne or oiliness. My husband already "claimed it" for his own.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this cleanser! I have really sensitive skin. Switching up my routine always makes me nervous because I get red and broken out really easily. That did not happen with this cleanser thank goodness. I thought it was really gentle and a little bit goes a long way. My skin feels cleansed, but still smooth. I don't have that feeling after using it like all of the softness of my skin has been stripped away. As I'm getting older, I'm 40, a gentle cleanser is important to me. This one is great.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This facial cleanser is exceptionally gentle and soothing. I have sensitive skin and rosacea, and the colloidal oatmeal effectively reduces redness. The inclusion of glycerin is also beneficial, as it prevents excessive dryness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice light non greasy face wash. Loved how light it felt. Great foam. Felt clean but not dry or stretched out skin. Helped with greasy sweaty skin post gym.
